name: Navigation
summary: Your Google Maps, Citymapper, OsmAnd, Organic Maps or Yandex Maps route, live on the glasses.
description: Start a route in Google Maps, Citymapper, OsmAnd, Organic Maps or Yandex Maps and it stays on your glasses as one live activity: the next turn and its distance, or the walk to the stop, the line to board and the stops left. The moment that matters beats once so it is not missed.
author: Anezium

listing.descriptionMarkdown:
## About

Start a route in Google Maps, Citymapper, OsmAnd, Organic Maps or Yandex Maps and Navigation keeps it on your glasses as one live activity: the next turn and how far it is, or the walk to the stop, the line to board and the stops left, with your arrival time. A new step flares on its own; a turn a few metres away, or the stop to get off at, beats once so it is not missed. When the app stops guiding, the activity ends.

## Your app, your route

Nexus routes nothing and draws no map. Navigation reads the guidance those apps already post as notifications, so it follows whatever route you chose in them: driving, cycling or on foot, and public transport in Google Maps and Citymapper. Open Navigation from the glasses launcher to see the whole current instruction.

## Switches

The plugin screen on the phone has a main switch and one per app, so any of them can be kept off the glasses without uninstalling anything. Switched back on, a route already running is picked up straight away.

## What it reads

Google Maps' guidance, Citymapper's GO trip, and the navigation notifications of OsmAnd, Organic Maps and Yandex Maps, and nothing else: every other notification is ignored before it is read. The route lives in memory while it lasts; nothing is stored, and nothing leaves the phone except what your glasses show.

## Needs

Notification Access for Navigation (a button on its screen), *Show on your glasses* in Nexus → Settings → Plugin access, and Rokid Nexus 1.5.0 on the phone and the glasses. Google Maps and Citymapper set to English, French or Korean, the wordings it reads; OsmAnd in English or French, Yandex Maps in English or Russian. maps.me is read too, but maps.me stops updating its own notification in the background on Android 11 and later, so use Organic Maps, built from the same code. In South Korea, where Google Maps only guides on public transport, Citymapper and Maps transit both work.

releases.notes:
- OsmAnd and OsmAnd+: the turn in words, its distance, the street and the
  arrival time, with the close-turn warning. Checked on a phone and glasses.
- Yandex Maps: driving distance, street and arrival time, in English or
  Russian. Checked on a phone and glasses, the distance counting down.
- Organic Maps: distance and street, updated while the app is in the
  background. Checked on a phone and glasses. Its arrows are pictures, so the
  glyph stays neutral.
- maps.me is read too, but maps.me itself does not keep guiding in the
  background on Android 11 and later: in picture-in-picture it posts nothing,
  and without it the distance freezes because Android denies its navigation
  service the location. Organic Maps, built from the same code, works.
- Each new app has its own switch.
